notes.title: M.E.C.H.A.: Demo Update [v.0.96]
notes.content:
Greetings to all humans and androids!

Today I'm launching a new update for demo version.

The main feature of this update - Workbench!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611290/3b9dfd4c3df8ea73499aac4b05af733f95c5fece.png"]
Along with this, the following items were added - Adamantite Bar | Orichalcum Bar | Mythril Bar | Palladium Bar | Tungsten Bar | Anthracite | Yellow Reagent | Purple Reagent | Green Reagent | Steel Bar | Metal Scrap.

Recipes have been added to the workbench - Armor Plate | Adamantite Bar | Orichalcum Bar | Mythril Bar | Palladium Bar | Tungsten Bar | Steel Bar | Pistol Ammo | Small-Caliber Ammo | Buckshot | Rifle Ammo | Laser Ammo | Energy Ammo.

The Fortune parameter has been significantly reworked.
The Perception parameter has been slightly reworked.

Added CAP to levels - max character level now - 20.

Added tooltips for already equipped weapons in the inventory. Now you don't need to unequip the weapon to see the stats.

Now you get experience for digging up crystals.
Now you get experience for opening chests.

Improved the system of "pushing" Rika away if she gets in the way.

Fixed weapons sticking in inventory after unequipping.

The loot system from corpses has been reworked.

Fixed mouse sensitivity settings.

Fixed hitbox for interaction with Rika.

Rewards in chests have been reworked.

Fixed impossibility of finishing off when the enemy is stunned.

Rika can now attack in melee.

--------------------------------------

This update also introduces some more mini-content and fixes a lot of minor things.

This version is already available for the game! Good luck! And... Rika is waiting for you!

notes.title: M.E.C.H.A.: Demo Update [v.0.94]
notes.content:
Greetings to all humans and androids!



Today I'm launching a new update for demo version. 

Let's go over the main features:



The first feature - Decrypting chests.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611290/a454f4fcf05b7593fd088f60d4fe5df70626bfdd.png"]This is a full-fledged mechanic for breaking chests. I hope you enjoy it.



The second feature - Healing Stimulators.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611290/04e78b76d3c4d8437937ea63a37364e63d35280c.png"]This mechanic allows you to quickly restore a certain amount of health without going into your inventory. Please note that the amount of health depends on the Vitality stat.



This update also introduces some more mini-content and fixes a lot of minor things.

This version is already available for the game! Good luck! And... Rika is waiting for you!

notes.title: M.E.C.H.A.: Demo Update [v.0.92]
notes.content:
Well, I'm releasing an update for the demo version. 
Let's go over the new features:

The first feature - Full-fledged menu with language selection.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611290/439499e4043d2ef5b81dc6a5d695a605f69b0823.png"]Currently, only two languages are supported. English and Russian. Keep that in mind.

The second feature - New player movement system.

So, In the previous version, I wanted to see how the players would appreciate the slow and atmospheric movement of the player. The experiment was generally successful, but it was noticeable that over time such a character's speed began to burden the players. Now it's time to completely turn the system around! 

Basic movement:
Walking ---> Jogging

In addition to this, a new mechanic was opened in the demo version - SPRINT.
Keep in mind that the duration of the sprint is directly affected by the Strength.

Well, besides these two features, the update introduces some more additions and fixes to the game.

This version is already available for the game! Good luck! And... Rika is waiting for you!
